mods.name: Drink Beer Rebrew
mods.description: Brewing, Bartering and Bartending. Unofficial Fabric port of Drink Beer Refill (NeoForge, archived) with upstream bugfixes and an EMI plugin.

block: Haar's Icey Pale Lager Recipe Board

releases.notes:
### Changes since 1.2.0-fabric.12

- **the keg no longer eats surplus ingredients.** A recipe consumes exactly one item per slot (the three wheat in a recipe are three separate slots), but upstream wiped the whole slot when brewing started: a stack of wheat put into a slot vanished for the sake of the single wheat the recipe needed, and bucket slots always came back as exactly one empty bucket. That is the eighth upstream bug fixed here.

Unofficial **Fabric 1.21.1** port of [DrinkBeer Refill](https://github.com/DragonsPlusMinecraft/DrinkBeerRefill/tree/f3b2bfb) `1.2.0` (NeoForge, commit `f3b2bfb`). Licensed **AGPL-3.0-only**, like upstream and Lekavar's original DrinkBeer.

**Requires:** Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric Loader >= 0.19, Fabric API. The same jar goes on both client and server. EMI is optional — brewing recipes show up in it when present.

Server-side behaviour is covered by an automated pass on a real Fabric server (`tools/prod-test.sh`); the client side (both GUIs, the renderers, drinking, effects, the EMI category) was verified in game.

### Seven upstream bugs fixed

Five of these break the mod on NeoForge as well, so upstream's bartending feature is unusable there:

- the bartending table crashed the server tick on the first spice (`SpiceData.fromSpiceList` read indices 1 and 2 without a length check)
- "drunk frost walker" was removed on its first tick (`applyEffectTick` returned `false`, which means "expired" since 1.20.5)
- the beer could not be taken off the table (`useItemOn` returned `CONSUME` for any item including an empty hand, so `useWithoutItem` never ran)
- no block dropped anything when mined (block loot tables sat in `loot_table/block/`, vanilla looks in `loot_table/blocks/`)
- the game crashed on the first player save after drinking a cocktail (effects were applied through `Holder.direct`, which cannot be serialised)
- a placed cocktail lost its base beer: nothing wrote the beer id or the spices into the block entity, so the mug rendered as a generic model and dropped as an empty-looking (but drinkable) mug
- cocktail names rendered as raw broken keys such as `block.drinkbeer.drinkbeer:beer_mug`, because upstream built translation keys from `Item#toString()`, which differs between loaders

### Russian locale review

The Russian translation had its meaning inverted in places — most notably the `refreshing` flavors were named "Опьяняющий" (intoxicating) while they actually *remove* drunkenness. Seventeen strings fixed, eight dead JEI/Jade keys dropped, and both languages now share exactly the same key set.

### Notes on the port

Loader layer only; upstream game logic is left as-is where possible. Recipe JSONs are used unchanged — the ingredient codec accepts both the NeoForge (`{"item"/"tag"}`) and the vanilla (`"id"`/`"#tag"`) shapes. The JEI plugin is replaced by an EMI plugin.

Everything that differs from upstream, including two bugs introduced by the port itself and then fixed, is documented in [PORTING.md](https://github.com/gen1nya/drinkbeer-refill-fabric/blob/fabric-1.21.1/PORTING.md) (in Russian).

### Credits

All the actual mod work belongs to upstream authors: [Lekavar](https://github.com/Lekavar) and [MarbleGateKeeper](https://github.com/MarbleGateKeeper) (the original Drink Beer), [Naetheline](https://github.com/Naetheline) (bartending & bartering), [yanang007](https://github.com/yanang007) (1.18.2 port, Jade integration), [DragonsPlusMinecraft](https://github.com/DragonsPlusMinecraft) (the Refill fork this is based on).
